authority: Pinned stable ExAV trunk and approved port decisions; wiki claims require branch/version/source reconciliation.
reviewMethod: Read all 15 top-level UTF-8 HTML article bodies under div#wikibody using inert HTML parsing. Exclude site navigation, ads, tag/edit widgets and footer text from findings; do not execute embedded scripts. Canonical URLs identify saved origins, not live-page verification.
scopeLimitations: Incomplete manual: two overview pages, twelve FAQs, one glossary; no detailed ExAV task chapters or complete parameter reference.
Articles mix versions 1/2, stable V2, experimental 2.2 and Prototype 3. Page modification dates do not identify an exact game build or capture date.

33 article image references; 25 decoded relative paths do not resolve verbatim locally. Some saved _002/_003 variants exist; their presence alone does not prove image identity. Only the two listed toolbar variants were visually inspected for this review.
No linked changelog, unsupplied article, test save or plugin download was reviewed as an additional input.
Source conclusions are cross-references to existing maintained ExAV reviews, not a fresh source audit or native/browser runtime evidence.
Older manuals, screenshots, changelog entries and original-source comparisons remain historical and non-normative even where ExAV instructions are missing.
MAN-E identifiers are documentation findings, not implemented operations or new completed action mappings; no implementation/acceptance status is promoted.
